title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.4.2
subtitle: Fresh Bakes stay fresh and resumable runs stay safe.

highlights.title: Reliable Fresh Bakes
highlights.description: A new Bake never appends to a stale partial from an earlier run, preventing intermittent cache overflows.

highlights.title: Resume When You Need It
highlights.description: Explicit Resume still continues from the matching authenticated partial and keeps completed frames available.

improvements.text: Each new Bake keeps its recovery files separate, preserving earlier playback while the new cache is created.
Viewport role colors and unrestricted shading choices from 2.4.1 remain available.

fixes.text: Fresh Bakes no longer trigger “more frames than declared were written” after a previous failed or cancelled run.
